excluded_population: severe74, excluded by the earlier explicit user instruction
comparator: fixed seed1 N3_SUBPIX, freshly reproduced on the identical245 IDs
missing_and_fallback: retain all245 ID rows; separately count new pose, N3 fallback and complete failure; compare full operational outputs and shared new-pose subsets without deleting large errors
paired_difference: new method error minus fresh N3 error on the same frame ID
performance_success: primary full operational mean translation and mean rotation are both below the fresh fixed N3 comparator; implementation success alone is insufficient
ablations: compare primary to the same pose policy with only native N3 observations and to the same primary coordinates with no self-hidden exclusion; report when learned observations or masking add no measured benefit
mask_diagnostics: human self-hidden states only after geometry seal; record mask disagreements and pose deltas separately; never fail a frame solely for a changed or wrong mask
corner_diagnostics: direct visible damage and actual hidden reprojection error reported separately from final pose errors
reference_limit: existing GEOMETRIC_PROXY development references; no independent physical pose GT or unseen-domain generalization certification
